item.title: TTT 396: Sharing Is Caring
item.description:
We visit the CBC and laugh at what those amateurs call entertainment. Also, Eric discovers why three is a better number than two.

We want to know “Who are you?” Send us an email, voicemail, tweet or whatever letting us know a bit about yourself and how you discovered Tip Tap Tip.

We are Calgary’s only Podcast.
